wy_age_blocked: We can't create an account on this device.
wy_age_id: Check my age with an ID
wy_age_id_note: If this is a mistake, a licensed partner can check your age with your ID. The partner charges a fee, shown before you start.
wy_age_id_sent: Your request is with the licensed partner. Follow their steps to show your ID, and the answer will show here.
wy_alert_note: A sign-in from a new device or place sends an alert to all your devices, with This wasn't me.
wy_app_lock: Ask for my fingerprint or face to open the app
wy_auth_note: Any standard authenticator app works. Scan the code or type the key, then type the 6 digits it shows.
wy_basic_limits: This account was opened on a basic phone. Add an email to use payouts, cards, exchange and Storefront selling.
wy_birth_confirm: You were born on {date}. Is this right?
wy_birth_invalid: This date doesn't exist. Check the day, month and year.
wy_birth_note: We use it only to check your age, then forget it. We never keep your birth date.
wy_birth_once: You can't change it after you confirm.
wy_blocked: Too many tries. This account now accepts only passkeys and security keys for 7 days.
wy_check_reachable: A working way to reach you
wy_check_second_way: Add a second way to sign in
wy_code_note: The code lasts 5 minutes and works only on this device.
wy_codes_make_new: Only a few codes are left. Make new ones.
wy_codes_none_left: No backup codes are left. Make new ones.
wy_contacts_note: 3 to 5 people you trust. If you lose every device, two of them confirm it's you.
wy_country_lock_note: Only allow sign-ins from the countries you choose. Leave it empty to allow every country.
wy_country_note: Your country sets your language, currency and the services shown first. You can change it later.
wy_email_note: We send a code to this email. Your account needs an email and a phone number.
wy_extra_note: This sign-in is new or unusual, so we ask for one more check.
wy_hold_note: LynkOmni never texts its own alerts. If an alert about a payout or contact change reaches you nowhere, the change waits until you open it or confirm on a device you used before.
wy_keys_note: A USB or tap key works like a passkey.
wy_legal_no_digits: A legal name has no numbers. Type it as on your ID document.
wy_legal_note: Exactly as on your ID document. It stays private and is only used when a check needs your real name. Your display name can be different.
wy_legal_too_long: The legal name is too long. Shorten it to 100 letters or fewer.
wy_legal_too_short: The legal name is too short. Type your full name as on your ID document.
wy_lock_first: First, lock everything: every session ends, cards are asked to freeze and keys pause.
wy_locked: Locked. Now get back in and look at the activity log.
wy_lost_done: If it matched, your account is locked now.
wy_lost_note: Lock your account without signing in. Use a backup code or your recovery code.
wy_offline_signup: Connect to the internet to create your account. What you typed is kept.
wy_org_note: On Max and Enterprise: security keys for owners and admins, the staff session length and own devices only.
wy_passkey_note: A passkey signs you in with your fingerprint, face or screen lock. There is no password to remember or steal.
wy_phone_note: We send a code to this number. A number alone never opens or recovers your account.
wy_po_consent: I agree to send my legal name and number to my mobile network for this check.
wy_po_free: This check is free for you. The network's own name for you is never shown or kept.
wy_po_id_doc: Your mobile network does not offer this check here yet, so our licensed identity partner checks your ID document instead.
wy_po_match: Your number is confirmed as yours. This stays for {n} days, or until your number or SIM card changes.
wy_po_network: Your mobile network compares your legal name with your number.
wy_po_no_match: Your network says this number is not in your name.
wy_po_note: Only for things that need the real owner of your number. Never for everyday sign-in.
wy_po_partial: Your name only partly matches what your network has.
wy_po_wait: Your SIM card changed recently. To keep your account safe, this waits until {when}.
wy_po_wait_how: Nothing to do. We ask the network again then.
wy_po_who: LynkOmni never pays for this check. The licensed partner of the service does it as part of its own checks, or whoever asks for it pays.
wy_privacy_screen: Hide amounts and names when my screen is shared
wy_problem_passkey_broken: My passkey or key doesn't work
wy_problem_someone_else: Someone else is in my account
wy_qr_note: Open LynkOmni on your signed-in phone and scan this code. It works once and ends in 2 minutes.
wy_recover_lead: LynkOmni has no passwords. Tell us what's wrong and we show the ways back in that you have.
wy_recovery_note: Write the recovery code on paper and keep it at home. Keep the 10 backup codes somewhere safe. They are shown only once.
wy_remember_note: On a shared computer, leave it off: you are signed out after 12 hours.
wy_restricted: For 24 hours: no payouts, payout changes, downloads, card changes or contact changes.
wy_step_email_code: The code sent to your email
wy_step_phone_code: The code sent to your phone
wy_step_recovery: Your recovery code and backup codes
wy_stopped: Stopped. We now ask an extra check at every sign-in for a while.
wy_strongest_note: Only passkeys and security keys. No codes by email or text. Changes wait 7 days.
wy_too_many: Too many new accounts were made from here in the last hour. Try again in an hour.
wy_turn_off_note: Turning a check off needs a fresh check and waits out the cool-off.
wy_unusual_impossible_journey: Two countries too close in time
wy_unusual_many_tries: Many tries in the last hour
wy_unusual_new_country: A sign-in from a new country
wy_waiting_note: We told every device and contact on your account. Any of them can stop this with one tap.
wy_way_contacts_note: We ask your recovery contacts to confirm it's you. Two must confirm.
wy_way_email_and_phone: Codes to my email and my phone
wy_way_email_code: Send a code to my email
wy_way_id_note: A licensed partner checks your ID document and your phone number. Two LynkOmni staff approve.
wy_way_other_device_note: Open LynkOmni on a device that is still signed in and approve.
wy_way_qr_code: Sign in with a QR code
wy_way_text_code: Send a code to my phone
wy_word_note: Your secret word appears in every real LynkOmni email and message. A message without it is not from us.
wy_word_rule: 3 to 30 letters, numbers or spaces, in any language. Capitals and small letters are kept exactly as you type them.
